issues.detail: The Hebrew 'מִפְּנֵי קֹשֶׁט' means 'from before the bow' (i.e., from the face of the bow/archery), referring to protection from the enemy's bow. The Vietnamese renders it as 'vì lẽ thật' ('because of the truth'), which is a mistranslation—'קֹשֶׁט' (qoshet) means 'bow' (weapon), not 'truth' (which would be 'אֱמֶת'). This changes the meaning of the verse.
